subject: Application as Project Manager Digital Services (m/f/d)
paragraphs: Muster GmbH is moving its customer services onto one shared platform, and the role you describe sits exactly where that work gets decided: between the people who know the processes and the teams who build the software. That is the place where I have worked for the past six years.

At Beispiel AG I led a programme that replaced four regional order systems with a single one. I gathered the requirements from eleven departments, turned them into a backlog the developers could plan with, and kept the scope stable through three releases. The last site went live two weeks ahead of plan.

What I bring to a project like yours is a habit of writing things down early. Before any line of code was written, every requirement had an owner, an acceptance test and a reason. This made later change requests short discussions instead of long ones, and it gave the steering committee a plain view of cost and progress each month.

I also enjoy the part of the work that happens after go-live. For the order platform I set up the first support rota, trained forty key users and tracked the open defects until the backlog was empty. Two of those key users now run the platform themselves.

I would be glad to learn more about your roadmap and to show how my experience fits your plans. I can start after a notice period of three months and am happy to travel to Musterstadt for a conversation at any time that suits you.
